jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (.NET)
jobs.why: Perfect match for a senior backend IC role in Saudi Arabia with clear technical requirements.

jd.text:
Job Summary

Responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable enterprise applications and backend services using Microsoft .NET technologies. The role involves collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver secure, high-performance solutions, translating business requirements into technical implementations, and contributing to the overall software architecture and development standards.

Key Responsibilities
• Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade web applications and backend services using C# and ASP.NET Core.
• Develop and maintain RESTful APIs and system integrations with internal and external platforms.
• Design and optimize relational databases using SQL Server and PostgreSQL.
• Apply software engineering best practices, including Domain-Driven Design (DDD), clean architecture, and design patterns.
• Collaborate with Product Managers, Business Analysts, and QA teams to deliver business requirements.
• Participate in solution design, technical reviews, and architecture discussions.
• Troubleshoot and resolve complex application issues across different system layers.
• Optimize application performance, scalability, and security.
• Mentor junior engineers and support knowledge sharing within the development team.
• Participate in code reviews and ensure adherence to coding standards and development processes.
• Manage source code using Git and participate in CI/CD workflows.

Required Qualifications
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
• 5+ years of experience in software development.
• Strong proficiency in C# and ASP.NET Core.
• Experience with ASP.NET MVC and Entity Framework Core.
• Strong knowledge of REST API development.
• Experience with SQL Server and PostgreSQL.
• Solid understanding of Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
• Experience with Git and version control practices.
• Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and analytical skills.
• Good understanding of software architecture and system design.
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with Angular.
• Experience with Dapper and LINQ.
• Experience working on payment platforms or fintech solutions.
• Experience developing HR, ERP, or enterprise business systems.
• Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies.

Technical Skills
• Languages: C#, Java
• Frameworks: ASP.NET Core, ASP.NET MVC, Entity Framework Core, ABP
• Frontend: Angular, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, jQuery
• Databases: SQL Server, PostgreSQL
• Architecture: REST APIs, Domain-Driven Design (DDD)
• Version Control: Git, TFS

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Frontend/UI-UX)
jobs.why: Senior IC role, but frontend/UI-UX focus is slightly adjacent to the candidate's core strengths.

jd.text:
About the Role

As a Senior Software Engineer with a Frontend/UI-UX specialty, you will define interaction architecture and deliver high-assurance, mission-critical digital platforms. Operating in an Agile environment, you'll solve complex usability challenges related to real-time data synchronization, cryptographic state visualization, and secure content handling. This role blends expert proficiency in design tooling (Figma) with robust front-end engineering (Vue.js, TypeScript), combining UX ownership with production-level UI implementation.

Responsibilities
• Architect user flows for applications requiring real-time state updates and low-latency user feedback
• Design unobtrusive visual indicators for data integrity, encryption status, and content protection layers
• Independently develop pixel-perfect, responsive components using Vue.js and TypeScript
• Implement complex client-side logic for dynamic content rendering and secure data presentation
• Ensure seamless integration with RESTful APIs and real-time WebSockets for live telemetry data
• Maintain and expand the internal Design System (icons, typography, atomic components) across web, mobile, and desktop
• Create high-fidelity interactive prototypes in Figma to validate complex workflows and state transitions
• Transform abstract security concepts (identity verification, data classification, regulatory compliance) into clear, human-readable interface elements
• Champion inclusive design, ensuring all interfaces strictly adhere to WCAG 2.1 AA standards

Requirements
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Design, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), or a related field
• 5+ years of professional experience in UI/UX design and front-end engineering
• Proven ability to architect, build, and deploy complex, stateful web applications (real-time dashboards, high-density data-processing interfaces)
• Clear track record of translating UX requirements into production-ready code within structured Agile/Scrum workflows
• Strong proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, and TypeScript, including secure integration of RESTful APIs and WebSockets
• Mandatory professional experience with the Vue.js ecosystem (Pinia, Vue Router)
• Expert proficiency in Figma (Auto Layout, Components, Prototyping)
• Comprehensive understanding of WCAG 2.1 AA guidelines and ARIA roles
• Proven ability to articulate and defend complex design decisions to engineering and product stakeholders in fluent English

Desirable Certifications
• Google UX Design Professional Certificate
• Certified Professional in Accessibility Core Competencies (CPACC)
• UX Certification from Nielsen Norman Group (NN/g)

jobs.title: Enterprise Networks & Data Center Engineer (L2 Operations)
jobs.why: Role is focused on network infrastructure operations rather than software/AI development.

jd.text:
Job Summary:

We are looking for a highly motivated Enterprise Networks & Data Center Engineer (L2 Operations) for one of our customers. The successful candidate will be responsible for providing second-line operational support, troubleshooting, incident resolution, and implementation support across the enterprise network and data center infrastructure in a 24x7 operational environment.

This role supports a modern enterprise infrastructure comprising Cisco Software-Defined Access (SDA), Cisco Wireless Fabric, Cisco Nexus Data Center networks, and Cisco WAN & Internet routing solutions.

Key Responsibilities:
• Provide L2 support for enterprise network and data center infrastructure.
• Troubleshoot and resolve complex network incidents.
• Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for recurring and major incidents.
• Implement approved network configuration changes following change management procedures.
• Monitor network performance, availability, and capacity.
• Support and troubleshoot Cisco Software-Defined Access (SDA) Fabric environments.
• Support Cisco Catalyst Center operations and network automation activities.
• Troubleshoot Cisco Catalyst switching environments, including Layer 2 and Layer 3 services.
• Support Cisco Catalyst 9800 Wireless Controllers, Cisco Access Points, Wireless Fabric, WLANs, and client connectivity.
• Administer and troubleshoot Cisco Nexus Data Center switching environments, including vPC, VLANs, Layer 2, and Layer 3 connectivity.
• Support Cisco WAN and Internet infrastructure, including Cisco ISR/ASR routers, MPLS, Internet, VPN, OSPF, BGP, NAT, and IP SLA.
• Perform network health checks, configuration validation, and post-change verification.
• Collaborate with L1 Operations, L3 Engineering, vendors, and Cisco TAC to restore services and resolve complex technical issues.
• Maintain accurate technical documentation, operational procedures, and incident records.
• Participate in planned maintenance activities and on-call support as required.

Required Technical Skills:
• Strong knowledge of Enterprise Routing and Switching.
• Hands-on experience with Cisco Software-Defined Access (SDA).
• Experience with Cisco Catalyst Center.
• Experience supporting Cisco Catalyst 9000 Series switches.
• Strong knowledge of Cisco Wireless solutions, including Catalyst 9800 Wireless Controllers and Access Points.
• Experience with Cisco Nexus 9000 Series switches and traditional Data Center networking.
• Good understanding of WAN technologies, including MPLS, Internet, VPN, BGP, OSPF, NAT, and IP SLA.
• Familiarity with network monitoring, troubleshooting, and incident management tools.
• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.
• Ability to work effectively in a 24x7 operational support environment.

Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
• 3–6 years of hands-on experience in Enterprise Network Operations or Data Center Operations.
• CCNP Enterprise certification is preferred.
• Cisco Data Center and Wireless certifications are considered an advantage.

jobs.title: AI/ML Specialist
jobs.why: JD specifies a graduate/entry-level role, which is a seniority mismatch for a senior candidate.

jd.text:
Artificial Intelligence Jobs Opportunity

Building and Maintaining Hierarchical/Hybrid Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) System with Agent Orchestration and RAG Architecture

Job Title: AI Developer, AI/ML/LLM Specialist – Graduate Python Developer

Job Description: Building and Maintaining Hierarchical/Hybrid Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

(MARL) System with Agent Orchestration and RAG Architecture using Python and

LangGraph of LangChain and other tools

Job Type: Full-Time

Location: Advanced Analytics, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

About Us

Advanced Analytics is a leading innovator in Decision Support Systems using artificial intelligence and multi-agent frameworks, dedicated to solving complex challenges through cutting-edge technology. We are seeking a talented and driven new graduate to join our team as a Python Developer to design and implement a Hierarchical/Hybrid Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) System with Agent Orchestration and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) Architecture.

This is an exciting opportunity to work on state-of-the-art AI projects that push the boundaries of what’s possible in multi-agent systems and knowledge-driven workflows.

Key Responsibilities

Develop Hierarchical/Hybrid MARL Systems:
• Design and implement multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) systems that utilize hierarchical or hybrid architectures.
• Apply advanced RL techniques, such as Centralized Training with Decentralized Execution (CTDE), MADDPG, and QMIX, to enable agent collaboration and coordination.

Integrate RAG Pipelines into Agent Workflows:
• Build Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines to optimize information retrieval and decision-making for agents.
• Leverage vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, FAISS, or Weaviate) and embedding techniques for context-aware retrieval.

Design Agent Orchestration Frameworks:
• Use LangGraph to create dynamic workflows for agent orchestration, where agents can invoke other agents, external tools, or APIs.
• Develop hierarchical agent structures with task-managing agents orchestrating sub-agents for specific problem domains.

Optimize System Performance and Scalability:
• Build scalable multi-agent systems capable of handling high-volume tasks and large-scale data.
• Optimize performance in distributed and cloud-based environments.

Collaborate and Experiment:
• Work closely with AI researchers, engineers, and developers to define system requirements and architectures.
• Conduct experiments to evaluate and iterate on MARL, RAG, and agent orchestration designs.

Write Clean, Modular Python Code:
• Develop maintainable and reusable code using best practices in Python development, including asynchronous programming, modular design, and version control.

Required Skills and Qualifications

Essential:
• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, or a related field.
• Programming Skills: Advanced Python skills, including experience with libraries such as NumPy, pandas, and scikit-learn.
• Multi-Agent Systems: Understanding of multi-agent systems, including hierarchical architectures and agent coordination.
• Reinforcement Learning (RL):
• Familiarity with RL algorithms such as Q-learning, DDPG, and Actor-Critic methods.
• Knowledge of MARL frameworks like CTDE, MADDPG, QMIX, or QTRAN.
• Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG):
• Experience with RAG pipelines for information retrieval and response generation.
• Familiarity with vector similarity search tools (e.g., Pinecone, FAISS, or Weaviate).
• LangGraph/Agent Orchestration: Knowledge of LangGraph or similar agent orchestration frameworks for building workflows.
• Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and debugging skills to tackle complex AI challenges.
• Team Collaboration: Excellent communication skills to work effectively in cross-functional teams.

Preferred:
• NLP and RAG Integration: Experience with NLP frameworks like Hugging Face Transformers for integrating language models into RAG workflows.
• Cloud and Distributed Systems: Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) for deploying and scaling multi-agent systems.
• Experimentation Tools: Experience with tools like Weights & Biases or TensorBoard for tracking RL experiments.
• Graph-Based Approaches: Knowledge of graph-based algorithms and tools (e.g., NetworkX) for agent relationships or task modeling.
• Knowledge Representation: Familiarity with knowledge graphs and ontologies for agent reasoning.
• Asynchronous Programming: Experience with multi-threading or asynchronous programming in Python for agent orchestration.

Tools and Technologies
• Languages and Libraries: Python, NumPy, pandas, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Stable-Baselines3.
• Multi-Agent and RL Frameworks: OpenAI Gym, PettingZoo, LangGraph, LangChain.AutoGen or CrewAI
• RAG and Vector Search Tools: Pinecone, FAISS, Weaviate, Milvus.
• Cloud Deployment: AWS, GCP, or Azure.
• Orchestration Tools: LangGraph, Docker, Kubernetes.
• Experiment Tracking: Weights & Biases, TensorBoard.

What We Offer
• Competitive salary, benefits and bonuses
• Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI and multi-agent systems.
• Mentorship and training to accelerate your career growth.
• A collaborative and inclusive work environment with flexible hours.
• The chance to make an impact with innovative AI solutions.

How to Apply

Submit your resume, a cover letter, and any relevant project portfolio to HR Manager. Ms. Mashael Alhazmi at <al.mashael@advtics.com>].

We’re looking for passionate individuals excited to make a difference in the field of AI and multi-agent systems!
